function.arguments:
{"script": "cd /home/user && python3 << 'EOF'
import FreeCAD
import Part

# Open the precondition file
doc = FreeCAD.open("/home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd")

# Get the current shape from Mirrored002 (the final shape before our modifications)
mirrored002 = doc.getObject("Mirrored002")
shape = mirrored002.Shape

print(f"=== Current Model Shape ===")
print(f"Shape type: {shape.ShapeType}")
print(f"Volume: {shape.Volume:.2f} mm³")

# Count faces
faces = shape.Faces
print(f"\nNumber of faces: {len(faces)}")

# Get bounding box
bb = shape.BoundBox
print(f"\nBounding Box:")
print(f"  X: {bb.XMin:.2f} to {bb.XMax:.2f} (size: {bb.XSize:.2f})")
print(f"  Y: {bb.YMin:.2f} to {bb.YMax:.2f} (size: {bb.YSize:.2f})")
print(f"  Z: {bb.ZMin:.2f} to {bb.ZMax:.2f} (size: {bb.ZSize:.2f})")

# Find the top and bottom faces (largest area, normal in Z direction)
import math
top_faces = []
bottom_faces = []

for i, face in enumerate(faces):
    normal = face.Normal
    area = face.Area
    # Check if face is roughly horizontal (normal close to Z axis)
    if abs(normal[2]) > 0.9:
        center = face.CenterOfMass
        print(f"Face {i}: Area={area:.2f}, Normal=({normal[0]:.2f}, {normal[1]:.2f}, {normal[2]:.2f}), Center=({center[0]:.2f}, {center[1]:.2f}, {center[2]:.2f})")
        if normal[2] > 0:
            top_faces.append((i, area, center))
        else:
            bottom_faces.append((i, area, center))

print(f"\nTop faces (normal +Z): {len(top_faces)}")
print(f"Bottom faces (normal -Z): {len(bottom_faces)}")

FreeCAD.closeDocument(doc.Name)
EOF
"}
